output.summary: First-look inventory record for Seat 1. I believe this is a four-player Session A kit centered on Mirevanta Works, Kestralyn, Corthaven, and Loopfold AI. It contains the baseline game but excludes Tactics, secret objectives, and Reserve Specialists. I inspected the supplied inventory/manifest before attempting any rules reading. The staged filesystem itself could not be opened because the read-only sandbox failed during initialization, so this record is based on the frozen manifest and component listing supplied in the prompt.
observedComponents: A Mirevanta Works faction set, apparently including a faction board, 1 CEO, 3 Teams, 4 double-sided Facilities, 1 Generator, 10 Scrutiny cubes, Customer and Escalation track markers, 6 Core Action cards, 7 Escalation cards, and a double-sided AGI Declaration card.

Equivalent player sets appear intended for Kestralyn, Corthaven, and Loopfold AI in Session A. The kit also contains content for Session B factions, though I would keep that material out of this session.
Each Facility appears to have normal and Grid-Ready faces. One first Facility carries an integrated starting-grid identifier rather than requiring a separate marker.
A 50-card Training deck: five copies in each of seven domains, plus three copies each of Curated Corpus, Licensed Dataset, Benchmark Leak, Synthetic Loop, and Human Evaluation.
Era-separated Headline cards, including some marked Advanced Play; resolved Headlines appear intended to form a visible timeline.
Era cards, Era Mandates, Power Source cards, Reference cards, faction boards, Core Action cards, Escalation cards, and map-related components.
Six numbered matched pairs of Joint Venture tokens.
Six numbered matched pairs of Mega-Cluster tokens, with some form of lead-side indicator.
One special Fusion Demonstrator marker.
Eighteen shared Systemic Risk cubes, visually or functionally distinct from each faction’s Scrutiny cubes.
One opaque Audit bag and one Initiative marker.
Digital production/support material: printable component masters, card/map/component references, world material, source JSON, manifests, receipt schema, and version/fingerprint labels.

No baseline Tactic deck should be placed out, even though the component documentation mentions a deferred 36-card contract. I also expect no secret-objective or Reserve Specialist material in the playable inventory.
sortingPlan: First separate Session A playable material from Session B material, release/source files, and expressly excluded modules.
Build four faction trays. For Mirevanta Works, group the board, CEO, Teams, Facilities, Generator, track markers, Scrutiny cubes, Core Actions, Escalations, and AGI Declaration card together.

Within my Mirevanta tray, place Facilities and Generator nearest the map, personnel together, the two track markers on the faction board, and the two card sets in separate face-up piles until setup clarifies their use.
As a capability rusher, visually scan Mirevanta’s components for research, training, infrastructure, power, grid, and AGI symbols—but do not infer their rules yet.
Sort Training cards into the seven domain types and five named special types to count them, then recombine them as one deck only after confirming all 50 cards.
Sort Headlines by Era, then separate Advanced Play cards from ordinary cards without shuffling anything yet.
Keep Era cards and corresponding Mandates together by Era, but in distinct stacks so similarly themed cards are not mixed.
Group shared infrastructure contracts by type and matched number: Joint Venture pairs in one row, Mega-Cluster pairs in another, preserving every lead-side orientation.
Place the Fusion Demonstrator marker separately so it cannot be mistaken for a generic facility or contract token.
Keep Systemic Risk cubes beside the Audit bag while keeping every faction’s Scrutiny cubes in its own color supply.
Place Power Sources and map tokens near the map; keep Reference cards at each seat once player ownership is visually clear.
Quarantine Tactics, secret objectives, Reserve Specialists, Advanced Play Headlines, and unused Session B faction material until instructions explicitly call for them.
